summary.text: Xiao Hu Chi is a rank seven Gu Immortal who leads Western Desert's Xiao clan Gu Immortals against hidden sand spider queens at the impassable dunes and opens a long term trade in regretful spiders with Fang Yuan.

claims.text: Xiao Hu Chi leads Xiao clan ‘s Gu Immortals against three hidden sand spider queens at the impassable dunes, immersing himself in the thrill of battle while deputy leader Xiao Shi Rang manages the group’s retreat timing. When Fang Yuan’s giant hand seizes a weakened queen from ambush and seven more giant hands rout the five rank six Gu Immortals, only Xiao Hu Chi and Xiao Shi Rang, the group’s two rank sevens, hold two of the hands on even terms. After Fang Yuan reveals himself peacefully and offers a long term trade in regretful spiders for Ten Thousand Li Silk Corridor’s mortal spider Gu needs, Xiao Hu Chi asks how many he can supply, then pays on the clan’s behalf in the first transaction while Fang Yuan receives a node token. Xiao clan ‘s first supreme elder praises Xiao Hu Chi’s handling of the matter, doubling his contribution points, though Xiao Hu Chi remains wary of how suddenly the powerful stranger appeared.
When Xiao Shi Rang meets Fang Yuan for a later delivery, he is known together with Xiao Hu Chi as Xiao clan ‘s brains and brawn duo.

During the chaos Fang Yuan incites around Central Continent’s Refinement Path Convention, Gu Immortals matching Xiao Hu Chi and Xiao Shi Rang attack glass mountain range, emptying the super force’s territory and killing the three Gu Immortals stationed there.

After a battle against Central Continent’s ten great sects ends, Xiao Hu Chi mocks the loser, then tries to negotiate splitting a contested resource with the Northern Plains demonic path Gu Immortal left beside him, Pi Shui Han. Pi Shui Han answers by telling him to scram, and when Xiao Hu Chi names himself a rank seven expert of Western Desert’s Xiao clan, Pi Shui Han attacks; after more than ten rounds Xiao Hu Chi is losing ground when Xiao Shi Rang arrives to join him. Even together the two are forced to retreat, and only afterward does Xiao Shi Rang identify their opponent as Pi Shui Han.
Spring Autumn Cicada carries the will of Fang Yuan’s future clone back to his time path clone, a rebirth that reaches years into the past.

In this life, as in the previous one, Gu Immortals from the other four regions follow Fang Yuan’s subordinates in plundering Central Continent’s resource points; Xiao Hu Chi, Xiao Shi Rang, and Pi Shui Han succeed in a joint plunder, then fight one another over dividing the spoils.
